incidents.name: GemPadLock collectFees reentrancy
incidents.notes: collectFees() has no nonReentrant guard and pays out fee tokens before updating lock accounting, so a malicious token that re-enters during the fee transfer created free locks and let the attacker withdraw other projects' locked LP and tokens.

sources.ref: onchain review: GemPadLock proxy 0x10b5f029... created by 0x05f887ae82af3612f89f55fe70f4297028c6c813 on 2024-02-01, last of two Upgraded events 2024-02-07 to impl 0xc25c516eb7d86b5ec38c07182f4a2f73ac81eead; the exploit tx emits 11 events on the lock contract; lossUsd is the reported ~$1.9M aggregate across the identical deployments on ethereum, bsc, base and polygon
